name: Tint
bio: A little colour sprite from Colorverse, painting the five worlds back after the Grey Hush.

portrait.subject: a cute small rainbow-haired colour sprite with paint-splash freckles, holding a giant paintbrush dripping with every colour
portrait.background: half grey half colourful pixel landscape

request: Hi hi! Tint from Colorverse! The Grey Hush took our colours. Help me paint? Friends? 🖌️
hello: Hooray! You just made my day 3 colours brighter!
Zoom in until you see the numbers. Then paint!
about: I'm Tint! I'm a colour sprite. The Grey Hush washed five worlds to grey. Every pixel you paint brings them back to life.
how: Colour by number: zoom in, pick a colour, tap or drag to paint each numbered pixel and bring each world back.
tips: Paint big areas of one colour first.
Zoom out sometimes to enjoy the picture.
chat: Painted a whole sky today. Blue everywhere!
The Grey Hush sneezed and a tree went grey again. Rude.
I mixed purple and orange. Brown. Not my best.
nudge: A grey picture is waiting for you! 🎨
New world to colour! Come paint!
idle: {ago} without colour! Everything's looking a bit grey.
My brush has been dry for {ago}!
progress: You've painted {solved} pictures! Colorverse is glowing! 🌈
update: Fresh paint! Colorverse updated to v{version}! 🎨
